# nico_metadata (Data Source)

Metadata describes various system-level attributes of the API service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nico_metadata" "example" {
  id = "resource-uuid"
}

output "metadata_name" {
  value = data.nico_metadata.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `build_time` (String) Date/time when the API was built
- `version` (String) Current version of the API
